intro: The Oracle Tree is a quest in which a promising adventurer is directed to commune with a sentient, ancient tree. By seeking out a piece of bark the tree has intentionally shed, travelers receive its soothing telepathic message and prepare for greater tasks ahead.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I am impressed by what you have accomplished here in so short a time, friend. Would that I could ask you to remain here to assist me with my duties... But I know in my heart that greater tasks lie ahead for you.
I have noticed the Oracle Tree has just shed a piece of its bark. No doubt it has a task that it wishes completed. You should speak with it.

clips.title: Completion
paras: As you inspect the fallen bark, a voice enters your mind. It is calm and soothing, cresting over you like a gentle breeze through the leaves.
